correctness.rationale: Fresh reconstruction confirms the formulas. The cyclicizer of D_{2n} is {1}; nonidentity rotations form an independent set in the noncyclic graph, reflections form a clique, and every rotation-reflection pair is adjacent, hence N(D_{2n})≅K_n∨\overline{K_{n−1}}. The Laplacian invariant subspaces give eigenvalues 0 once, n with multiplicity n−2 and 2n−1 with multiplicity n. Matrix–Tree then gives \(n^{n-2}(2n-1)^{n-1}\); the spectral resistance formula gives (2n−1)[(n−2)/n+n/(2n−1)]=3n−5+2/n. The finite checker n=3,...,8 is consistent but unnecessary for the general proof.

originality.rationale: The final claim is covered by prior graph-theoretic results once the already-known dihedral graph structure is recognized. Ma–Wei–Zhong's cyclic-graph description is equivalent, after deleting the identity and complementing, to the complete-split model. Das–Liu (2016) specifically study complete split graphs and their Laplacian spectrum. A 2026 primary paper on graph joins gives the Kirchhoff index of a general complete split graph \overline{K_m}∇K_n; setting m=n−1 yields exactly 3n−5+2/n. The spanning-tree formula is then the routine Matrix–Tree consequence of the known Laplacian spectrum. Thus the advertised dihedral spectrum/tree/Kirchhoff package is not original under the required implication-based standard.
